mechanic: Normal hangman letter guessing. A correct curriculum question unlocks exactly one unused letter guess; wrong question answers retry with no letter penalty. Incorrect letters add a gallows part; six letter misses lose. Solve two words. The hidden word is supplied by the question content, not game code.
questionCountNote: 50 unique questions per level. A round only ever moves forward through them: losing, answering wrong, or pressing Play again continues at the next unseen question, so the pool must outlast many rounds.
distractorRules: Wrong options must be single words of the same kind as the hidden word — same part of speech, similar length and letter count, same difficulty. No option may be identifiable by its shape or position; each must be a word a learner at this level could plausibly mistake for the answer.
